skillDispatch.when: Preparing a repository to use local Specs.
Clarifying a creative Spec direction before authoring requirements.
Creating the researched idea artifact for a large initiative.
Creating the Spec Task Graph and Task files.
Implementing one Task file without crossing its slice.
Implementing the complete Task Graph in dependency order.
Producing the final QA verdict for a completed Spec.
Moving a completed, QA-passed Spec into the archive.
Writing or revising any Spec artifact or verification record.

rules.guidance: Keep each Spec under `docs/specs/<feature-slug>/`. Dependencies live only in `_tasks.md`; status lives only in each Task file. Execute only the assigned Task slice, record fresh evidence in its Result, and never edit another Task file while doing so.
Keep `_idea.md`, `_prd.md`, `_techspec.md`, `_tasks.md`, Task files, and `qa/` evidence under the Spec folder. Archive only completed Specs with a passing QA verdict under `docs/specs/_archived/`.
